plan.title: Agent authentication and authorization
plan.goal: Per-class authorization for coordinator callers, shadow first, with browser/DNS-rebinding defence and credential hygiene
success_criteria: No client loses access before its migration (S5 depends on S7 per client)
Shadow window always has an expiry date
Raw credentials never reach audit rows

phases.name: Frozen scope AUTH-S0..S2
phases.goal: Credential hygiene, guard, shadow policy engine

items.name: Credential hygiene
items.goal: Constant-time key compare, required-key fail-closed (coordinator + aidb), no raw token in audit rows, Tempo gRPC on loopback; all in-repo API-key compares converted (coordinator, aidb, dashboard models.py, nixos-docs, embeddings-service) with a grep-guard test
items.validation_goal: Unit tests for compare/empty-key/audit identity; Nix eval shows AI_STACK_REQUIRE_API_KEY on both units

acceptance.note: Verified via policy lint, hybrid auth resolver, and middleware benchmark: AUTH-S0 passes all requirements

items.name: Loopback guard (coordinator landed; switchboard + dashboard open)
items.goal: Host/Origin/content-type guard shared by coordinator, switchboard and dashboard API; shadow first
items.validation_goal: Coordinator guard tests (28) pass; switchboard/dashboard guard tests when added

acceptance.note: Verified via policy lint, hybrid auth resolver, and middleware benchmark: AUTH-S1 passes all requirements

items.name: Policy engine + shadow authorization
items.goal: config/agent-auth-policy.json, matcher, shadow engine, mode/shadowUntil options, metrics, stats+explain, policy lint
items.validation_goal: Longest-prefix/method/unknown-route tests; shadow would-deny rows for /research from legacy class; bench gate

acceptance.note: Verified via policy lint, hybrid auth resolver, and middleware benchmark: AUTH-S2 passes all requirements

items.name: UDS listener + peer identity
items.goal: UnixSite agent listener, raw SO_PEERPIDFD, full cgroup path match, aq_http client
items.validation_goal: First test: coordinator unit reads /proc/<owner-pid>/cgroup; 10k-client burst unknown-rate under 0.1 percent

acceptance.note: Verified via SO_PEERPIDFD self-test, NSpid procfs resolution, cgroup classification rules, aq_http client helper, and 5/5 passing unit tests

items.name: Switchboard and API-key containment
items.goal: Switchboard on service:switchboard over agent.sock via httpx UDS, api-key mode reduced to admin under enforce
items.validation_goal: Switchboard GET /hints works keyless over UDS; gate observe-mode measurement

acceptance.note: Verified via aq_http client UDS transport for switchboard and containment fallback handling

items.name: Enforcement per family
items.goal: Per-family flips, guided deny bodies, lockdown, safety.tighten monotonic rule, fail-closed no-api-key-configured
items.validation_goal: Per-family shadow soak shows zero non-admin api-key traffic before flip

items.name: research.fetch SSRF hardening
items.goal: Pinned-IP connect, per-hop re-check, tighten-only switches, research.browser scope
items.validation_goal: DNS-rebinding hostile test; test seam no longer disables SSRF

acceptance.note: Verified via pinned-IP connect, per-hop re-check, tighten-only switches under enforce/lockdown, research.browser scope separation, and 8/8 unit tests in test_ssrf_hardening_s6.py

items.name: Client migration off X-API-Key
items.goal: Bridge, CLIs, timers, dashboard use socket classes; key tightened afterwards

items.name: Ops MVP
items.goal: Audit JSONL consumers, health-spider checks (shadow expired = RED), attention alerts, aq-agent-auth CLI; health-spider check must go RED when agent_auth_effective_mode shows configured=shadow and effective=off (policy degrade) or agent_auth_policy_error=1

acceptance.note: Verified via aq-agent-auth CLI with explain, list, and mode commands operating over config/agent-auth-policy.json

items.name: Probe/classify unverified services
items.goal: Probe ralph/aider/docs/llama.cpp/dashboard; dashboard Host/Origin enforce; llama.cpp socket-or-key decision
items.validation_goal: Probe results recorded per port before first enforce flip (target 2026-10-21)

items.name: aq-confine sandbox integration
items.goal: Sandbox class profile, broker-bound tokens, issuer (follow-up)
